newsitem.title: USA: Plamsa sees possible Q3 oper loss.
newsitem.headline: Plamsa sees possible Q3 oper loss.

text.p: Plasma & Materials Technologies Inc Tuesday said it will report either a modest operating profit or operating loss for the third quarter.
The company said it also anticipates that it will report a net profit for the quarter.
Revenues for the quarter are expected to fall to $8.75 million from $10.2 million in the second quarter. A year ago, revenues were $6.5 million.
Plasma reported a profit of $0.06 a share in the third quarter a year ago.

In a statement, the company said third quarter revenues were adversely affected by the delay in an anticipated shipment of a single PMT system to a customer who had previously accepted two systems during the third quarter.
Plasma said it currently derives most of its quarterly revenue from the sale of a small number of etch systems which typically have list prices ranging from about $975,000 to $3.1 million.
As such, the timing of the shipment of a single system can have significant effect on the company's revenues and can adversely affect its quarterly operating results.
